# Revstage

> Revstage is a local-first BOM (bill of materials) control workspace for small hardware teams. Version 0.3.0 for Mac is available to download from this site.

## Positioning

Revstage is being built for small hardware teams that have outgrown spreadsheet BOMs. Its product direction focuses on released revisions, reference designators, approved manufacturer-part alternates, where-used context, and inventory locations in a workspace managed by the customer.

Revstage is not an ERP, MRP, purchasing system, supplier quote service, hosted BOM cloud, or compliance product. Core BOM work is designed not to depend on a hosted cloud service or a server to run.

## Features (0.3.0)

- BOM import from CSV, TSV, XLSX and KiCad exports with reference-designator and quantity checks
- Revision compare and engineering change orders (review, approve, release, audit trail)
- Approved, conditional, and blocked alternate status
- Where-used analysis across products and revisions
- Inventory quantities and bin locations
- BOM cost from imported DigiKey/Mouser quote exports or manual prices
- Team sharing on the customer's own network (Team edition)

## Availability and pricing

- Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 12 or later): download from https://partspan.evelyn-ai.com/#download with a 14-day free trial.
- Revstage Pro: US$100 per year, one person. Revstage Team: US$300 per year, up to 10 people.
- Website purchases are sold by Polar; a license file is emailed after purchase.
- Mac App Store release is in review; iPad will follow.
- The earlier public PartSpan v0.1.1 release is a legacy build.

## Privacy and support

Revstage does not require hosted BOM storage. Privacy policy: https://partspan.evelyn-ai.com/privacy/ . Support: https://partspan.evelyn-ai.com/support/ .

This public site does not contain or link to the private product source code.
